title: Concept: Cargo dependency follows a git branch
description: Cargo.toml declares a git dependency pinned to a branch instead of a revision, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The branch moves, so every build can compile a different tree while the manifest and the review record stay identical.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The branch moves, so every build can compile a different tree while the manifest and the review record stay identical.
